headline: Will you love me on the private?
dek: A Friday fun day music video imagines the boys from Tufa as a boy band, with Dries Smit at the microphone.

sections.heading: The song and the scene book
sections.text:
What if the boys from Tufa Labs were a boy band? Put their charismatic lead singer Dries Smit on the microphone, give him a public score to fall for, and let the private leaderboard play hard to get. Welcome to On the Private, our Friday fun day love song. Watch the full video, then explore the scene book below, shot by shot.

Mark Barney produced the video. Lyria 3 Pro made the music and voice; GPT-6.1 Terra / Codex created the stills; Wan 3.0 and HeyGen Avatar IV animated the scenes; and Claude Fable 5.2 Medium drew the graphics in code and cut the video. The characters come from The Loose Goose, an Autoresearch-Arena publication.

sections.heading: New to Kaggle?
sections.text: Kaggle’s public leaderboard shows scores on part of the test data; final results use a separate hidden part. A model that shines on the public board may not do as well on the private one.
